workflows.definition:
name: Auto LSP CI

# Plan 416 6-A (2026-08-22): push triggers RESTORED, scoped to the LSP
# crates via `paths` (the old always-red state came from the fmt job checking
# the ENTIRE workspace — 9000+ files are not rustfmt-clean and mass-reformat
# is a separate decision; the job now checks `cargo fmt -p auto-lsp` only).
# Local gate before re-enabling: cargo check/test/fmt -p auto-lsp all green.
on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "crates/auto-lsp/**"
      - "crates/a2r-std/**"
      - ".github/workflows/auto-lsp-ci.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "crates/auto-lsp/**"
      - "crates/a2r-std/**"
      - ".github/workflows/auto-lsp-ci.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Cache cargo index
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Cache cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-target-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Check auto-lsp
        run: cargo check -p auto-lsp

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Cache cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}
      - name: Run auto-lsp tests
        run: cargo test -p auto-lsp

  fmt:
    name: Rustfmt
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: Check formatting (fmt-clean packages: auto-lsp, a2r-std)
        run: |
          cargo fmt -p auto-lsp -- --check
          cargo fmt -p a2r-std -- --check

workflows.definition:
# Build + registry drift regression for examples/bps-gallery — the blueprint
# catalog browser (PLAN-676 Auto 化: 壳消费 layout/gallery-shell BP via L1,
# 目录发现数据源 = 生成的 src/front/registry.at; SD-01 取代 PLAN-640 的
# import.meta.glob 零产物裁定——Auto 化后 VM 臂无法读盘, 双臂同源要求
# 静态表). blueprints/** 或发射器变更经两道闸:
#   ① registry 漂移校验 — 重跑 `auto bp list --format at` 与提交产物 diff,
#     非空即红 (防手改 registry.at / 漏提交再生物);
#   ② `auto build` — gen + vue-tsc + vite 全链 (壳 SFC + 蓝图引用编译).

name: Build bps-gallery

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
    paths:
      - 'examples/bps-gallery/**'
      - 'blueprints/**'
      - 'crates/auto/**'
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-bps-gallery.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'examples/bps-gallery/**'
      - 'blueprints/**'
      - 'crates/auto/**'
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-bps-gallery.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build auto CLI
        run: cargo build -p auto

      - name: Registry drift check (PLAN-676 SD-01)
        run: |
          ./target/debug/auto bp list --format at > /tmp/registry.at
          if ! diff -u examples/bps-gallery/src/front/registry.at /tmp/registry.at; then
            echo "::error::registry.at drifted from blueprints/** — rerun \`auto bp list --format at > examples/bps-gallery/src/front/registry.at\` and commit the regenerated artifact"
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 11

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Build (auto build — vue arm full chain)
        working-directory: examples/bps-gallery
        run: ../../target/debug/auto build

steps.name: Build (auto build — vue arm full chain)

workflows.definition:
# Build regression for examples/ui — runs `auto build --gen-only` on a
# representative set of UI examples so generator/parser breakage shows up in
# CI instead of only on local machines.
#
# Scope note: this gates the .at → Vue SFC generation pipeline (parse,
# ui_gen, post-generation validators). It deliberately skips the npm
# install + vite build phase: per-example npm installs are too heavy for
# this matrix, and 015-notes declares `npm_deps` with `link:` entries
# pointing at absolute local paths (D:/autostack/...) that cannot resolve
# on a CI runner. Full npm-level verification stays a local workflow.

name: Build UI examples

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
    paths:
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - 'crates/auto-man/**'
      - 'crates/auto/**'
      - 'examples/ui/**'
      - 'examples/bp-admin/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-ui-examples.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - 'crates/auto-man/**'
      - 'crates/auto/**'
      - 'examples/ui/**'
      - 'examples/bp-admin/**'
      - '.github/workflows/build-ui-examples.yml'

jobs:
  gen-only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      # PLAN-689：matrix 项为仓根相对全路径（examples/ui/… +
      # examples/bp-admin），working-directory 直接取 ${{ matrix.example }}
      # ——047 迁出后若沿用 "examples/ui/${{…}}" 前缀会复刻 PLAN-657 T-04
      # 清掉的四条同型死目录项。
      matrix:
        example:
          # Baseline smoke coverage
          - examples/ui/001-helloworld
          - examples/ui/002-counter
          # Classic CRUD
          - examples/ui/013-todo
          # Most complete app; link: npm_deps are fine here because
          # --gen-only never reaches the npm install phase
          - examples/ui/015-notes
          # PLAN-657: L1 multi-package blueprint assembly sample (four bp
          # packages, zero copy) — keeps the bps dep-scan + back #[api]
          # generation under CI. PLAN-689: migrated to a standalone
          # examples/bp-admin (no longer under examples/ui).
          - examples/bp-admin
          # NOTE (PLAN-657 T-04 hygiene): entries 026-keyboard-mouse-events /
          # 027-native-css / 028-dom-escape / 029-external-imports were removed
          # — those examples moved to examples/capability-tests/ in the
          # 021-040 reorg (cfc1bfe23) and the matrix kept pointing at dead
          # dirs. capability-tests gen coverage is a separate debt.
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build auto CLI
        run: cargo build -p auto
      - name: auto build --gen-only (${{ matrix.example }})
        working-directory: ${{ matrix.example }}
        # PLAN-689：matrix 项现为不同深度的仓根相对路径（examples/ui/X
        # 两层 / examples/bp-admin 一层），exe 路径用 $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
        # 绝对形态，不再依赖固定层级数的 ../ 回退。
        run: $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/auto build --gen-only

workflows.definition:
# Deploy Auto Language Website to GitHub Pages
#
# This workflow builds the Auto Language documentation website
# and deploys it to GitHub Pages.
#
# PLAN-590 (Stage B P-5): widgets-gallery 物理迁 auto-os 顶层——画廊构建
# 段改为 checkout auto-os(auto-stack/auto-os)并从 auto-os/widgets-gallery
# 构建(auto CLI 仍由本仓框架构建)。画廊源变更在 auto-os 仓发生,本仓
# push 触发器看不见——手动/workflow_dispatch 的 `gallery` 输入强制重建
# 画廊快照;auto-os 侧自动触发(repository_dispatch)随 P-6/auto-os CI 立起。
# 构建产物同步 website/public/ui/gallery,站点在 /ui/gallery/ 服务该快照。

name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      gallery:
        description: 'Rebuild the widgets-gallery snapshot from auto-os'
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Stage B P-6（PLAN-009 T7）：auto-os 侧画廊/app 变更经 repository_dispatch
  # 触发（event_type=deploy-website）——等价 gallery=true 手动 dispatch。
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [deploy-website]

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Build job
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout auto-lang
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: auto-lang

      - name: Checkout book repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: autostack/book
          path: book
          # If the book repo is private, you may need a token:
          # token: ${{ secrets.BOOK_REPO_TOKEN }}

      # PLAN-590: widgets-gallery 随 Stage B P-5 迁 auto-os 顶层。
      - name: Checkout auto-os repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: auto-stack/auto-os
          path: auto-os

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      # --- widgets-gallery build (PLAN-590: source now in auto-os; manual
      #     dispatch input forces rebuild — auto-os-side auto trigger lands
      #     with P-6 / auto-os CI) ---
      - name: Setup Node
        if: github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.gallery == true)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Setup pnpm
        if: github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.gallery == true)
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: '9'

      - name: Setup Rust
        if: github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.gallery == true)
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Build auto CLI
        if: github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.gallery == true)
        run: cargo build --release -p auto
        working-directory: auto-lang

      - name: Build widgets-gallery
        if: github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.gallery == true)
        run: |
          ../../auto-lang/target/release/auto build
          rm -rf ../../auto-lang/website/public/ui/gallery
          mkdir -p ../../auto-lang/website/public/ui/gallery
          cp -r gen/front/vue/dist/* ../../auto-lang/website/public/ui/gallery/
        working-directory: auto-os/widgets-gallery
        env:
          # shadcn-vue add / pnpm install run inside `auto build`
          PNPM_HOME: /home/runner/.local/share/pnpm

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          cd auto-lang/website
          bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Prepare Content
        run: |
          cd auto-lang/website
          node scripts/prepare-content.js

      - name: Build Website
        run: |
          cd auto-lang/website
          bun run build

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ./auto-lang/website/.vitepress/dist

  # Deployment job
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

workflows.added: 999f9aa55da730aced0e324e51ca547b81f22b23|2026-08-07T02:04:28+08:00|feat(plan-317): §11 Phase 11 — HTTP e2e 测试 CI 基建 + flaky 缓解
workflows.definition:
name: http-e2e

# Plan 317 §11 Phase 11: HTTP e2e regression gate.
#
# Runs the 7 HTTP e2e tests (formerly #[ignore]) that start a real TCP HTTP
# server and validate the full #[api] → serve_async → handler → response
# pipeline (struct JSON, path params, SSE, concurrent SSE, CRUD). Gated behind
# the `test-http-e2e` feature. Run via `cargo th` locally (nextest alias).
#
# IMPORTANT — known flakiness profile:
#   - The 4 non-SSE tests (struct/int-path/notes-crud/notes-list) are 100%
#     stable in isolation and in-suite.
#   - The 3 SSE tests (generator/indirect/concurrent) expose a scheduling
#     sensitivity in serve_async's spawn_local + yield_now path: under heavy
#     machine load (many concurrent processes / loaded CI runner), a connection
#     can hit the 5s read-timeout before all SSE frames flush. This is a real
#     nondeterminism in the cooperative schedule, NOT a server correctness bug.
#   - Mitigation: nextest runs each test in its OWN process (full isolation,
#     no detached-server-thread accumulation across tests), serially
#     (--test-threads 1), and we retry transient flakes (--retries 2). An
#     isolated CI runner with no competing load makes the flakes vanishingly
#     rare. If this job flakes repeatedly, the deeper fix is a controlled
#     serve_async shutdown (see plan-317 §11 Phase 11 "follow-up").
#
# Kept separate from auto-lsp-ci.yml (which only tests auto-lsp) so SSE
# scheduling sensitivity can't break the core build.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/auto-lang/src/vm/ffi/http_server.rs'
      - 'crates/auto-lang/src/vm/ffi/stdlib.rs'
      - 'crates/auto-lang/src/vm/engine.rs'
      - 'crates/auto-lang/src/lib.rs'
      - 'crates/auto-lang/Cargo.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/http-e2e-ci.yml'
  push:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  http-e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install nextest
        run: cargo install cargo-nextest --locked || true
      - name: Run HTTP e2e tests (serial, process-isolated, retry flakes)
        # PLAN-658: +ui-iced — back_proxy media/031/media-uri e2e 挂此档
        #（cfg ui-iced 门）；既有 7 例语义与 feature 无关，仅编译面变大。
        run: cargo nextest run -p auto-lang --lib --features test-http-e2e,ui-iced http_e2e --test-threads 1 --retries 2

steps.name: Run HTTP e2e tests (serial, process-isolated, retry flakes)

workflows.added: 688857fdba13ecc8370de92d3f8d7d324391ac7b|2026-07-17T14:23:05+08:00|ci: add parity p1/p2 gate on PRs touching a2r/auto-lang/parity (Plan 358 C2)
workflows.definition:
name: parity

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - 'crates/a2r-std/**'
      - 'crates/auto/**'
      - 'parity/**'
      - '.github/workflows/parity-ci.yml'
  push:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  parity-p1-p2:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: ". -> target\nparity -> parity/target"
      - name: Build auto binary
        run: cargo build -p auto --release
      - name: Run parity p1 (base64, url)
        working-directory: parity
        run: cargo run -p auto-parity -- --auto-binary ../target/release/auto phase p1
      - name: Run parity p2 (serde_json, regex)
        working-directory: parity
        run: cargo run -p auto-parity -- --auto-binary ../target/release/auto phase p2
      - name: Generate parity dashboard
        working-directory: parity
        run: cargo run -p auto-parity -- --auto-binary ../target/release/auto report --output docs/parity-dashboard.html
      - name: Upload parity dashboard
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: parity-dashboard
          path: parity/docs/parity-dashboard.html
      - name: Upload parity artifacts on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: parity-failure
          path: parity/

  parity-dep-real-crates:
    # PLAN-594: 真三方 crates.io 库三轨对拍（libs/dep/*_real；base64 为全红
    # 样本不注册）。网络档——AUTO_LANG_PARITY_NET=1 允许拉取/构建三方 crate
    # （VM methods pack、a2r 测试 crate、oracle tests/rust 三处消费）。
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      # VM 腿自由函数面（430/212 methods pack）依赖 nightly rustdoc。
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: ". -> target\nparity -> parity/target"
      # 产物缓存：a2r 测试 crate 的 target（runner 硬编码 bin_dir/target，
      # 无法用 CARGO_TARGET_DIR 共享）与 oracle tests/rust/target。键挂
      # parity 工具+dep 语料 hash——语料或工具不变时免付 auto-lang 冷构建。
      - name: Restore dep-parity build artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            parity/libs/dep/*/build_a2r/*/target
            parity/libs/dep/*/tests/rust/target
          key: parity-dep-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('parity/crates/auto-parity/**', 'parity/libs/dep/**') }}
      - name: Build auto binary
        run: cargo build -p auto --release
      - name: Run parity p10 (dep real-crate corpora, network tier)
        working-directory: parity
        env:
          AUTO_LANG_PARITY_NET: "1"
        run: cargo run -p auto-parity -- --auto-binary ../target/release/auto phase p10
      - name: Upload parity artifacts on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: parity-dep-failure
          path: parity/

steps.name: Run parity p10 (dep real-crate corpora, network tier)

workflows.added: 2a2e40d753ce75c5a86fe7bb110a9f3f8600c576|2026-08-25T03:44:22+08:00|ci: vm-files-ci.yml —— test-vm-files 门控测试接入 CI(430 复审补网收尾)
workflows.definition:
name: VM corpus and aavm tier tests

# 430 复审补网(2026-08-25):aavm2 六道闸门(M1 lexer/M2 AST/M3 .type/M4 字节码/
# M5 行为/主里程碑)与 vm 文件级 golden 原挂在独立语料档 cargo feature 后
# 接入 CI 守护(默认 `cargo test` 此前不执行)。PLAN-700(2026-09-24):该 feature
# 随语料三族常驻化退役——语料族(goldens/conformance/cookbook/gallery fence)
# 模块常驻,用测试名筛选即可;aavm2 闸门保持 `test-aavm` feature(已独立化)。
#
# 分层策略:
#   - gates / goldens / ffi_dual / conformance:必须绿(确定性 golden 级断言);
#   - cookbook:非阻断(continue-on-error)——其中 4-5 例为环境相关的既有失败
#     (本地 Windows 与 CI ubuntu 均有波动),先收集信号不动基线;
#   - nightly 工具链供 ffi_dual_013 的方法 shim 包管线真实执行
#     (缺失时该用例自身会优雅跳过)。

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - 'auto/lib/**'
      - 'crates/auto-cache/**'
      - 'crates/shim-metadata/**'
      - '.github/workflows/vm-files-ci.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'crates/auto-lang/**'
      - 'auto/lib/**'
      - 'crates/auto-cache/**'
      - 'crates/shim-metadata/**'
      - '.github/workflows/vm-files-ci.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  # Stage B P-6（PLAN-009 T6 / 590-R4）：画廊语料围栏（gallery_pages_compile
  # 等）经 resolve_os_top_dir 解析序定位 auto-os/widgets-gallery——CI 缺
  # auto-os 时整体静默 SKIP（solo-skip 语义），checkout 兄弟仓 + env 权威臂
  # 使围栏在 CI 激活。
  AUTO_OS_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/auto-os

jobs:
  vm-files:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # Stage B P-6：画廊语料仓（widgets-gallery 迁 auto-os，PLAN-590）——
      # 语料围栏激活依赖；sparse 只读 checkout，无构建。
      - name: Checkout auto-os (gallery corpus)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: auto-stack/auto-os
          path: auto-os
          sparse-checkout: |
            widgets-gallery
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      # PLAN-639 T-08：Block→Blueprint 重命名完整性门（复活模式封禁）
      - name: Blueprint rename guard (no Block-tier resurrection)
        run: python scripts/blueprint_rename_guard.py

      - name: Gallery corpus fences active (not SKIPPED)
        run: |
          test -f "$AUTO_OS_ROOT/widgets-gallery/pac.at" || { echo "auto-os checkout 缺 widgets-gallery"; exit 1; }
          echo "auto-os gallery corpus present: $AUTO_OS_ROOT/widgets-gallery"

      # Stage B P-6：画廊全页编译围栏（本地 cargo t/tf 门禁面，PLAN-590 起
      # 语料在 auto-os——CI 此前 solo-skip 静默跳过，本步骤使其在 CI 真跑；
      # schema_drift/docs_gen 集成档仍留本地 t/tf 门禁）。
      - name: Gallery pages compile fence (corpus from auto-os)
        run: >
          cargo test -p auto-lang --lib --
          gallery_pages_compile --test-threads=1

      - name: aavm2 six gates (M1-M5 + milestone + compile corpus)
        # Plan 514 W2 (P511-2 口径收窄清偿): compile corpus 腿已去 ignore,
        # 常规口径即覆盖;--include-ignored 移除(按需 rustc 探针保持 ignored)。
        # Plan 568: aavm 系测试迁入 test-aavm feature。PLAN-700: 语料三族
        # 常驻化后该 feature 独立(不再 imply 语料档),本步骤命令形态不变。
        run: >
          cargo test -p auto-lang --lib --features test-aavm --
          test_aavm2 --test-threads=1

      - name: VM goldens + ffi_dual (incl. 014 std generated segment)
        run: >
          cargo test -p auto-lang --lib --
          vm_file_tests ffi_dual --test-threads=1

      # PLAN-592: dep 三轨行为对拍——VM/oracle 腿 + a2r 全量档(env 门控,
      # CI 侧打开;冷构建 ~2-3min/腿,产物按内容 hash marker 缓存)
      - name: dep three-leg parity (VM/oracle/a2r, PLAN-592)
        env:
          AUTO_LANG_DEP_PARITY_A2R: "1"
        run: >
          cargo test -p auto-lang --lib --
          ffi_dep_parity_tests --test-threads=1

      - name: Conformance goldens
        run: >
          cargo test -p auto-lang --lib --
          conformance_tests --test-threads=1

      # 非阻断:收集 ubuntu 侧 cookbook 信号(既有环境相关失败不动基线)
      - name: Cookbook VM (non-blocking signal)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: >
          cargo test -p auto-lang --lib --
          cookbook_vm_tests --test-threads=1

steps.name: Gallery pages compile fence (corpus from auto-os)
aavm2 six gates (M1-M5 + milestone + compile corpus)
VM goldens + ffi_dual (incl. 014 std generated segment)

workflows.decision: remove: unused deployment or consistently failing unmaintained checks; local gates preserved
